create_keys_set: create a secret keychain entry using keys.set('api_key', 'sk-abc123') to store a secret value
create_keys_set_from_file: create a secret keychain entry from a file using keys.set('token', file='/path/to/token.txt')
retrieve_keys_use: retrieve a stored secret using keys.api_key.use() to get the raw value without printing
list_keys_ls: list all stored secret names using keys.ls() which returns a list of key names
review_SecretStr: review the SecretStr class that wraps secrets with masked repr and a .use() method to retrieve the raw value
